description_en: Places, renews, or modifies orders for specific products of Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise Edition, such as monthly duration packages
description_zh: 本接口为无影云电脑企业版按月时长包等部分商品的下单、续费、变配接口
kebab_example: aliyun wss create-multi-order --order-items '[{"Components":[{"Value":"cn-shanghai","Key":"RegionId"}],"PaidCallBackUrl":"example-string","PromotionId":"youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank","ResourceIds":["ecd-7ywwjrhpy9fec0000"],"Amount":1,"AutoRenew":false,"Period":1,"ResourceType":"DurationPackage","BuyChange":true,"AutoPay":true,"InstanceIds":["example-string"],"PeriodUnit":"Year"}]' --order-type create --properties key=example-string --reseller-owner-uid 1 --channel-cookie example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMultiOrder

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
fields.name: auto_pay

fields.help_en: Specifies whether this is a change purchase
fields.name: buy_change

fields.help_en:
The value of the module.

The following section describes the sample values and valid values for each key of the Enterprise Edition monthly duration package:

RegionId: ap-southeast-1
InstanceType: eds.enterprise_office.4c8g
DurationType (hours): Valid values: 
120
250
OsType: Valid values: 
Windows
Linux
RootDiskSize (GiB): 80
RootDiskCategory: Valid values: 
cloud_efficiency (ultra cloud disk)
cloud_auto (ultra-fast cloud disk)
cloud_essd (enhanced standard SSD. Only specific instance types support this value.)
RootPerformanceLevel: Valid values: 
PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
DataDiskSize (GiB): Valid values are the same as those of RootDiskSize.
DataDiskCategory: Valid values are the same as those of RootDiskCategory.
DataPerformanceLevel: Valid values are the same as those of RootPerformanceLevel
fields.help_zh:
模块的值（value）。

企业版按月时长包各个键的示例值/枚举值如下：

RegionId：cn-shanghai
InstanceType：eds.enterprise_office.4c8g
DurationType（小时）：[枚举] 
120
250
OsType：[枚举] 
Windows
Linux
RootDiskSize（GiB）：80
RootDiskCategory：[枚举] 
cloud_efficiency（高效云盘）
cloud_auto（极速云盘）
cloud_essd（增强型SSD云盘，仅部分规格支持）
RootPerformanceLevel：[枚举] 
PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
DataDiskSize（GiB）：取值同RootDiskSize
DataDiskCategory：取值同RootDiskCategory
DataPerformanceLevel：取值同RootPerformanceLevel

fields.name: paid_call_back_url

fields.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If PeriodUnit is set to Year: 1, 2, 3, and 5.

If PeriodUnit is set to Month: 1, 2, 3, and 6
fields.help_zh:
购买周期。取值范围：

当`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围：1、2、3、5。

当`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围：1、2、3、6
fields.name: period

fields.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration for a subscription instance.

This parameter is required only when the billing method of the instance is subscription. This parameter is case-sensitive. Make sure that the value is spelled correctly
fields.help_zh:
包年包月实例的购买时长单位。

仅当实例的付费类型为预付费时，需要填写此参数。该参数区分大小写，请确保拼写正确
fields.name: period_unit

fields.help_en:
The list of resource IDs.
For monthly duration packages, this parameter corresponds to the cloud desktop ID. This parameter is required when OrderType is not set to `create`
fields.help_zh:
资源ID列表。
对于按月时长包，该参数对应云电脑ID，OrderType非`create`时必填
fields.name: resource_ids

fields.help_en:
The resource type.
This parameter is case-sensitive. Make sure that the value is spelled correctly
fields.help_zh:
资源类型。
该参数区分大小写，请确保拼写正确
